scope: One original PLY-3 GUI Split/Extract, public MCP project export and full artifact download, and same-session GUI reopen with post-reopen history

processSamples.units: private committed bytes; sampled every two seconds outside the job
processSamples.note: These are nearby point samples, not the job peak or proof of allocation ownership. Chrome without a --type argument is labeled unclassified.

limitations: This is one passing instrumented run with only about 40 MiB of headroom; earlier same-workflow runs exceeded the limit.
The process samples do not identify a specific allocation or establish a general resource guarantee.
Other M2 native, parity, review, integration and milestone closure gates remain open.
